items.author: Associated Press
items.content:

items.title: Who comes after Trump? Republicans weigh the GOP's 2028 future
items.author: Associated Press
items.content: <article>Republicans are already looking ahead to 2028. At the party’s midterm convention in Dallas, attendees floated names including Vice President JD Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Texas Sen. Ted Cruz. Although Vance made a splash with his primetime speech, there was no clear consensus on who should succeed President Donald Trump.</article>

items.title: Philippines coast guard brings bodies to shore after ferry fire killed at least 35
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>A Philippine Coast Guard vessel arrived at Port of Borac on Saturday with a series of bags containing the remains of people killed in a ferry fire disaster. The death toll rose to 35 people on Friday, after more bodies were recovered by emergency service personnel, from the burnt vessel near southwestern Palawan Province.

items.title: France's military jets go on a 40-day global flight to project power and alliance
items.author: Associated Press
items.content:
<article>The military exercise called Pegase 26 aims to project military might and prove the nuclear power can defend distant territories and allies by strengthening French cooperation in the air with strategic partners including Japan, South Korea, Indonesia and India. The Associated Press accompanied French planes this week over Greenland and Alaska and during exercises they conducted with U.S. fighter jets.
